provenance: Original native SVG utility glyphs authored for Slay the Math, extending its existing SVG icon system. No supplied artwork was modified or regenerated.
frame: Shared double gold octagon, navy inset and four diamond studs; the central glyph carries the meaning.
rules: DESIGN.md: navy and gold theme, labels accompany color
presentation: Use beside a live label and numeric value. Tooltip text comes from DCCombatStatus.view. Buff, debuff and queued states remain labeled; glyphs differ independently of color. No text, counts, animation, scripts or external resources are baked into these files.
mechanics_owner: dist/engine.js and dist/card-combat.js; this package only projects their current values.

Moving boot with three trailing speed marks
Full shield with a protective check mark
Broken diagonal sword with a visible gap in the blade
Shield split by a large jagged crack
Curving vine bearing three angular thorns

Shield with a plus beneath a forward turn arrow
Shield encircled by a returning retention arrow
